Name: Cajole
Information:
**Cajole**

Humanoid infiltrators created by Luminal Minus to aid Outer Titans in circumstances where pure strength may not be the best option. Though large by mortal standards for humanoids, the cajole are small compared to their titan brethren. Like the Outer Titans, they are part of Luminal Minus’ hivemind, and are expressionless extensions of the Grand Primary’s will.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The titan uses its Penetrating Psych, then attacks using its Spear Arm.

actions.name: Penetrating Psych
actions.description: One creature the titan can see within 60 feet has their mind filled with horrific visions of the deaths of those on Luminal Prime. They must succeed a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the start of the titan’s next turn.

actions.name: Spear Arm
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
